== Editing the family navigator ==
Shared Versions navigator for the Premiere [[Luke Skywalker]] publication family across Decipher, Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy and Virtual Modern. Every listed publication includes <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its infobox.

Add a verified publication once in the appropriate era and set group. Use its canonical article title and a concise label; retain the full article title and publication details on the article. Configure the new article to include the same navigator. Preserve the existing entries and their order. The current article highlights automatically.

The optional <code>current</code> parameter supports [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT/Luke versions pilot|sandbox previews]]. A template change can require dependent-page cache refreshes; verify the rendered family after publishing. Restore the saved pre-edit revisions to revert the pilot, using revision guards to preserve intervening edits.
</noinclude>
